title: Lou Chudd, advance pressings and disc jockey power
summary: Chudd leaned on a few distributors and disc jockeys on what to release, sometimes against Bartholomew; the DJ scandals moved power to program directors.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship
